901.en: Many graduates seek work experience before further study.
901.zh: 许多毕业生在继续深造前寻求工作经验。

902.en: Did you find the reference book you were looking for?
902.zh: 你找到要找的那本参考书了吗？

903.en: Researchers hope to discover new species in the deep sea.
903.zh: 研究人员希望在深海发现新物种。

904.en: The new test can detect the disease at an early stage.
904.zh: 新的检测方法能在早期发现这种疾病。

905.en: Can you identify the main idea of each paragraph?
905.zh: 你能找出每段的中心思想吗？

906.en: I didn't recognize her with her new haircut.
906.zh: 她换了新发型，我都没认出来。

907.en: It is hard to distinguish the twins from each other.
907.zh: 很难把这对双胞胎区分开。

908.en: Colour helps the map differentiate land from water.
908.zh: 颜色帮助地图区分陆地和水域。

909.en: Please separate the glass from the paper for recycling.
909.zh: 回收时请把玻璃和纸分开。

910.en: The teacher will divide the class into two teams.
910.zh: 老师会把全班分成两队。

911.en: Let's split the cost of the taxi between us.

912.en: Try not to break the equipment in the lab.
912.zh: 尽量不要弄坏实验室的设备。

913.en: A crack appeared in the wall after the earthquake.
913.zh: 地震后墙上出现了一道裂缝。

914.en: The vase fell from the shelf and shattered on the floor.
914.zh: 花瓶从架子上掉下来，摔得粉碎。

915.en: The fire destroyed most of the old market hall.
915.zh: 大火烧毁了旧市场大厅的大部分。

916.en: The storm damaged the roof of the sports hall.
916.zh: 暴风雨损坏了体育馆的屋顶。

917.en: Chemicals from the factory could harm river fish.
917.zh: 工厂排放的化学物质可能危害河里的鱼类。

918.en: He hurt his back while lifting heavy boxes.

919.en: Warm up properly so you don't injure your muscles.
919.zh: 好好热身，以免肌肉受伤。

920.en: The nurse cleaned the wound and covered it with a bandage.
920.zh: 护士清洗了伤口并用绷带包扎。

921.en: Tell the doctor exactly where you feel the pain.
921.zh: 告诉医生你到底哪里疼。

922.en: Coastal towns suffer badly during hurricane season.
922.zh: 飓风季节沿海城镇损失惨重。

923.en: Desert plants can endure months without rain.
923.zh: 沙漠植物能忍受数月无雨。

924.en: The old bridge cannot bear the weight of heavy lorries.
924.zh: 这座旧桥承受不住重型卡车的重量。

925.en: The library does not tolerate noise in the quiet zones.
925.zh: 图书馆的安静区不容许喧哗。

926.en: It took him time to accept life in a new country.
926.zh: 他花了一段时间才接受在新国家的生活。

927.en: The school has embraced new teaching technology.
927.zh: 这所学校欣然采用了新的教学技术。

928.en: The staff welcome new students at the airport.
928.zh: 工作人员在机场迎接新生。

929.en: In some cultures people greet each other with a bow.
929.zh: 在某些文化中，人们以鞠躬互相问候。

930.en: Let's meet outside the lecture theatre at two.
930.zh: 我们两点在阶梯教室外见面吧。

931.en: Hikers may encounter wild deer on this trail.
931.zh: 徒步者在这条小径上可能会遇到野鹿。

932.en: Many small shops face strong competition from supermarkets.
932.zh: 许多小商店面临超市的激烈竞争。

933.en: The city must confront its growing waste problem.
933.zh: 这座城市必须正视日益严重的垃圾问题。

934.en: The findings challenge the traditional view of dinosaur behaviour.
934.zh: 这些发现对恐龙行为的传统观点提出了挑战。

935.en: Dozens of teams compete for the university cup each year.
935.zh: 每年都有数十支队伍角逐大学杯。

936.en: She entered a national essay contest and won first prize.
936.zh: 她参加了全国作文比赛并获得一等奖。

937.en: Doctors are working hard to fight the spread of the virus.
937.zh: 医生们正在努力抗击病毒的传播。

938.en: Some first-year students struggle to manage their time.
938.zh: 一些大一学生难以安排好自己的时间。

939.en: The town fought a long battle against the new motorway plan.
939.zh: 小镇为反对新高速公路计划进行了长期斗争。

940.en: The museum has letters written during the war.
940.zh: 博物馆收藏有战争期间写的信件。

941.en: The two countries finally signed a peace agreement.
941.zh: 两国最终签署了和平协议。

942.en: Try to stay calm during the speaking test.
942.zh: 口语考试时尽量保持镇静。

943.en: The top floor of the library is a quiet study area.
943.zh: 图书馆顶层是安静的自习区。

944.en: The audience fell silent as the lights went down.
944.zh: 灯光暗下来时，观众安静了下来。

945.en: Keep still while the nurse takes your blood pressure.
945.zh: 护士量血压时请保持不动。

946.en: The lizard stayed motionless until the danger had passed.
946.zh: 蜥蜴一动不动，直到危险过去。

947.en: The traffic was stationary for half an hour after the accident.
947.zh: 事故发生后，车流停滞了半个小时。

948.en: The patient is now in a stable condition.

949.en: There has been a steady rise in student numbers.
949.zh: 学生人数一直在稳步上升。

950.en: The lab must be kept at a constant temperature.

951.en: The machine records continuous data on air quality.
951.zh: 这台机器连续记录空气质量数据。

952.en: Continual interruptions made it hard to finish the essay.
952.zh: 不断的打扰让论文很难写完。

953.en: She has found a permanent job at a research institute.
953.zh: 她在一家研究所找到了一份长期工作。

954.en: The trip left a lasting impression on the students.
954.zh: 这次旅行给学生们留下了持久的印象。

955.en: The two scientists formed an enduring friendship.
955.zh: 两位科学家结下了持久的友谊。

956.en: The novel explores eternal themes of love and loss.
956.zh: 这部小说探讨爱与失去的永恒主题。

957.en: The universe may be infinite in size.
957.zh: 宇宙的大小可能是无限的。

958.en: The ticket gives you unlimited travel for one month.
958.zh: 这张票让你在一个月内不限次数乘车。

959.en: Her boundless energy inspired the whole team.
959.zh: 她无穷的活力鼓舞了整个团队。

960.en: The desert seemed endless as we drove west.
960.zh: 我们向西行驶时，沙漠似乎无边无际。

961.en: Countless tourists photograph this bridge every day.
961.zh: 每天都有无数游客拍摄这座桥。

962.en: The plan was rejected for numerous reasons.
962.zh: 该计划因众多原因被否决。

963.en: Many students choose to live off campus in their second year.
963.zh: 许多学生在大二时选择住在校外。

964.en: The essay question has multiple possible answers.
964.zh: 这道论述题有多种可能的答案。

965.en: Several lectures were moved online this week.
965.zh: 本周有几场讲座改到了线上。

966.en: Few people know about this quiet beach.
966.zh: 很少有人知道这个安静的海滩。

967.en: Some courses require students to do fieldwork.
967.zh: 有些课程要求学生做野外调查。

968.en: Call me if you have any questions about the timetable.
968.zh: 如果你对时间表有任何疑问，请给我打电话。

969.en: Every student must attend the safety briefing.
969.zh: 每个学生都必须参加安全说明会。

970.en: Each answer is worth two marks in this section.

971.en: All applications must arrive before the end of June.
971.zh: 所有申请必须在六月底之前送达。

972.en: She spent the whole weekend revising for the test.
972.zh: 她整个周末都在复习备考。

973.en: The entire building was closed for repairs.
973.zh: 整栋大楼因维修而关闭。

974.en: The total cost includes accommodation and meals.
974.zh: 总费用包括住宿和餐饮。

975.en: The list of course books is not yet complete.
975.zh: 课程书目清单还不完整。

976.en: Please write your full name in capital letters.
976.zh: 请用大写字母写下你的全名。

977.en: The lab equipment gets a thorough check every month.
977.zh: 实验室设备每月接受一次彻底检查。

978.en: The handbook gives a comprehensive guide to campus services.
978.zh: 这本手册对校园服务作了全面的介绍。

979.en: Keep detailed notes of everything you observe.
979.zh: 对你观察到的一切做详细记录。

980.en: The palace is decorated with elaborate stone carvings.
980.zh: 宫殿装饰着精美复杂的石雕。

981.en: The human brain is an extremely complex organ.
981.zh: 人脑是一个极其复杂的器官。

982.en: The booking process is too complicated for many users.
982.zh: 预订流程对许多用户来说太复杂了。

983.en: The last question in the test was really difficult.
983.zh: 考试的最后一道题真的很难。

984.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
984.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。

985.en: The first term abroad can be tough for new students.
985.zh: 在国外的第一个学期对新生来说可能很艰难。

986.en: Translating poetry is a challenging task.
986.zh: 翻译诗歌是一项有挑战性的任务。

987.en: Medicine is one of the most demanding degree courses.
987.zh: 医学是要求最高的学位课程之一。

988.en: The campus is easy to reach by public transport.
988.zh: 乘公共交通很容易到达校园。

989.en: The recipe is simple and takes only twenty minutes.
989.zh: 这个食谱很简单，只需二十分钟。

990.en: Write your answers on a plain sheet of paper.
990.zh: 把答案写在一张白纸上。

991.en: The course covers the basic principles of economics.
991.zh: 这门课程涵盖经济学的基本原理。

992.en: Trust is fundamental to a good working relationship.
992.zh: 信任是良好合作关系的根本。

993.en: A good dictionary is essential for language learners.
993.zh: 一本好词典对语言学习者来说必不可少。

994.en: It is necessary to book the study rooms in advance.

995.en: A valid passport is required for the exchange programme.
995.zh: 参加交换项目需要有效护照。

996.en: Attendance at the first lecture is compulsory.

997.en: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory in most countries.
997.zh: 在大多数国家系安全带是强制性的。

998.en: The safety course is obligatory for all lab users.
998.zh: 所有实验室使用者都必须参加安全课程。

999.en: The statistics module is optional in the final year.
999.zh: 统计学模块在最后一年是选修的。

1000.en: Participation in the survey is entirely voluntary.
1000.zh: 参与这项调查完全出于自愿。
